sloka: नह्यन्यो देवदेवेश त्वामृते मधुसूदन ।गतिः परायणं नास्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ।। ७.२७.१० ॥
transliteration: nahyanyo devadeveśa tvāmṛte madhusūdana ।gatiḥ parāyaṇaṁ nāsti trailokye sacarācare ।। 7.27.10 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, O Lord of gods, O Madhusudana, there is no other refuge or ultimate resort in the three worlds, with all their moving and non-moving beings, except for you.
